Update a QWAmetadata object to match a QWAimages object

Source: R/partial_update.R
update_QWAmetadata.Rd

Replaces the $images component of x with images and updates the hierarchical tables ($sites, $trees, $woodpieces, $slides) accordingly:

  • the hierarchy columns and counts (n_trees, n_woodpieces, n_slides, n_images) are derived from images; species_code is kept from x where it is NA in images,

  • all other columns are kept from x,

  • rows for IDs new in images are added (other columns NA),

  • rows for IDs no longer in images are removed.

Usage

update_QWAmetadata(x, images)

Arguments

x

a QWAmetadata object

images

a QWAimages object; the complete set of images of the updated dataset

Value

An updated QWAmetadata object

Details

Tables that are NULL in x remain NULL (see complete_QWAmetadata()). The image columns set in the apps (colType "meta_input", e.g. only_ew, img_comment from the metadata app, and "qc_input", e.g. comment_handled from the flags app) are filled from x$images where they are missing or NA in images, e.g. after rebuilding it with build_QWAimages().

Submission files only; TRIA dataset files are not edited.

See also

update_QWAimages(), update_QWAdata(), check_QWAmetadata()
